design_philosophy: A high-end, premium corporate portfolio designed for a Digital Marketing Executive. It balances dark luxurious aesthetics with sharp, data-driven professionalism. The layout emphasizes asymmetry and bento-grid structures to present the 'Hire Me' and 'Experience' sections side-by-side.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main layout structures to allow asymmetrical bento-grid designs.
Install and use 'react-icons' for the social media section (FaInstagram, FaLinkedin, FaFacebook, FaXTwitter). The user strictly wants real logos.
Ensure the Google Font 'Poppins' (weights 400 and 700) is imported in index.css and applied globally or via Tailwind config.
For the Graphic Design Portfolio, implement Shadcn Tabs. Use the provided portfolio_placeholders to populate the tab contents.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and major section wrappers.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations (fade-up, stagger children) as the user scrolls.
Wrap the meta ad screenshots in a subtle glassmorphism or neat border card with rounded corners to make them look premium.
For the hero background, use the provided hero_background_abstract image with a heavy black overlay (e.g., bg-black/60) so it acts as a subtle texture behind the Bento grid.
